sloka: चिंतयामास धर्मात्मा सह उपाध्यायः स बान्धवः ।तस्य चिंतयमानस्य मंत्रि मध्ये महात्मनः ॥१-१८-३८॥
transliteration: ciṁtayāmāsa dharmātmā saha upādhyāyaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ ।tasya ciṁtayamānasya maṁtri madhye mahātmanaḥ ॥1-18-38॥

translations.english: Desirous of seeing the king (Dasaratha) he accosted the doorkeepers, saying "Inform the king quickly about the arrival of Viswamitra, the son of Gadhi born in the line of Kusika".
